No.55/1/1/91-Cab.
GOVERNMENT OF INDIA (BHARAT SARKAR)
CABINET SECRETARIAT (MANTRIMANDAL SACHIVALAYA)

#/texts/5.label: paragraph
#/texts/5.full_gt_text:
The undersigned is directed to state that the Ministers as
shown in the Annexure have relinquished their respective office
with effect from 21st June, 1991.

#/texts/7.label: paragraph
#/texts/7.full_gt_text:
To

All Members of the Council of Ministers.

#/texts/8.label: paragraph
#/texts/8.full_gt_text:
Copy forwarded for information to :-

Secretary to the President.
Secretary to the Vice-President.

#/texts/9.label: paragraph
#/texts/9.full_gt_text:
(V.R. Srinivasan)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.

#/texts/10.label: paragraph
#/texts/10.full_gt_text:
Copy also forwarded for information to:-

Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Special Secretary to the Prime Minister.
Additional Secretary to the Prime Minister.

#/texts/11.label: paragraph
#/texts/11.full_gt_text:
(V.R. Srinivasan)
Deputy Secretary to the Cabinet.
